snippet.title: Tanner Chidester
snippet.description:
I went from making $2,000 in two years to over $141 Million in sales, all in under 8 years. This channel is how.

I grew up one of 7 kids, chased the NFL, dropped out of college, and spent two years knocking doors and doing pest control. Then I learned to sell high ticket products and services.

Today I run multiple 7 and 8 figure companies and partner with founders on profit share. What I teach here is what my team actually runs.

- Paid ads that stay profitable as you scale spend
- Funnels that turn cold traffic into booked calls
- Hiring, scripting, and training closers
- Offer design and pricing for high ticket
- What breaks at 7 figures and how to fix it

This is for founders who want to scale aggressively, not founders just starting out.

WORK WITH ME: We partner with 7 & 8 Figure Founders on profit share
https://stan.store/tannerchidester?utm_source=ytbio

Results not typical. For education only.

snippet.title: Raj Shamani
snippet.description:
Figuring Out is a podcast for people who want to learn.

It connects the world’s sharpest minds to the 1.4 billion Indians who want to build, grow, and win on a world level.

Raj Shamani sits across from the world's top 1%: leaders, entrepreneurs, athletes, and experts to give you a masterclass in what it actually takes to reach the top of a global stage.

It is pure education in what, how, and where to start building. World’s best playbooks, strategies, and stories for the generation that wants to turn their ambitious dreams into reality.

Millions of people tune in every day because they trust Figuring Out to always bring them value. And that trust is something we take seriously, every single episode.

But the mission has always been bigger than that. Figuring Out has become a place where the world comes to talk to India. And where India comes to learn from the world.

A movement for 1.4 billion people to put India's voice in front of the world.

Subscribe to become a part of it.

snippet.title: The iScale
snippet.description:
The iScale, formerly known as 'Industries Helping Hands,' was established with a mission to democratize upskilling. Recognizing the challenges faced by millions of learners, our founders prioritized affordability to address widespread skill and financial gaps, ensuring accessible pathways to personal and professional development.

The iScale acts as a catalyst, empowering college students, freshers, and working professionals to acquire industry-specific skills. Built on the pillars of innovation and community collaboration, we aspire to revolutionize the skilling of learners. The iScale is not just a platform; it is a transformative journey toward a future-ready workforce, unlocking doors to a world of exciting and meaningful career possibilities.
